failures.invalid_input: Invalid display or connection. Desktop supports direct routes only; check proxy and jump settings.
failures.conflict: The connection configuration, route or certificate trust has changed. Check it and reconnect.
failures.limit_exceeded: Desktop capacity is full. Try again after another session closes.
failures.operation_unknown: The remote operation could not be confirmed.
failures.request_failed: The request could not be completed.
failures.cleanup_failed: Local cleanup could not be confirmed. Close this window before opening another desktop.

fileClipboard.title: File clipboard
fileClipboard.uploadHint: Choose files, then press Ctrl+V in the destination folder on the remote desktop. You can also paste local files when your browser provides them.
fileClipboard.waiting: Files are ready. Close this panel and paste in a remote folder.
fileClipboard.uploading: Transferring files to the remote desktop…
fileClipboard.uploaded: Files transferred to the remote desktop.
fileClipboard.downloadHint: Copy files on the remote desktop, then download them here. Files inside folders can be downloaded individually; directories are not archived.
fileClipboard.empty: No files on the remote clipboard
fileClipboard.failed: File transfer did not complete. Check the remote clipboard and destination folder, then select or copy the files again.

certificate.title: Confirm RDP server certificate
certificate.subject: Issued to
certificate.remember: Remember this certificate; ask again if it changes

reasons.untrusted: The certificate authority could not be verified. Check the fingerprint and confirm you trust this server before connecting.
reasons.expired: The certificate is expired or not yet valid. Check its fingerprint and the server clock before connecting.
reasons.hostname_mismatch: The certificate does not match the connection address. Check the fingerprint to confirm this is the expected server.
reasons.changed: The server certificate differs from the remembered certificate. Verify why it changed; an unexpected change may indicate impersonation.
